question: Should this dashboard agent-status widget be accepted as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin now, or should it wait for the broader `sessions.activity.*` Gateway contract before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: The UI request is coherent and aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but choosing the permanent source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Review linked dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution while requiring its review, proof, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 lands a richer `sessions.activity.*` source, then implement the widget against that stable API.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing and close this issue only after its unique status-widget requirements are preserved there or implemented.

recommendation.title: Review linked dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution while requiring its review, proof, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on the Control UI plugin-tab seam and Sessions UI surfaces that frame the product/API choice.
